attributes.title: tag_get_config
attributes.description: Read bounded Tag configuration with system.tag.getConfiguration, plus the Tag config fingerprint (`tcf1:`) of exactly the configuration the read returned: the Precondition token tag_update compares. One exact UDT definition can be read (recursive=false) so a CONFIG Mutation's token can be obtained; the recursive view of the definition namespace stays udt_type_get's.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Absolute provider-qualified Tag, Folder, or UDT instance path, or one exact [provider]_types_/... definition with recursive=false.

parameters.name: recursive
parameters.description: Whether to include descendants. Default false.

parameters.name: overridesOnly
parameters.description: For UDT members on supported Ignition versions, return only overridden properties. Default false.

parameters.name: maxResults
parameters.description: Maximum configuration nodes after recursive expansion, 1..200. Default 50.
